values.ONE_LEG: Standing on one leg (kicks, teeps, knees). Exploited by catch-kick takedowns, sweeps, counter crosses.
values.HANDS_LOW: Guard is down (lazy jab return, shot attempt, fatigue). Exploited by overhands, head kicks, knees.
values.HEAD_LOW: Head below the opponent's chest (level change, shot). Exploited by knees, guillotines, front headlocks, uppercuts.
values.COMING_IN: Stepping in to tie up or shoot, hands busy (clinch entry, the start of a shot). Exploited by jabs, crosses, teeps and knees, which stop the entry (#18).
values.LEANING: Weight overcommitted forward (wild hook/overhand). Exploited by counter hooks, trips, level changes.
values.BACK_TO_CAGE: Pinned against the fence. Exploited by cage takedowns and clinch knees.
values.HELD_ON_FENCE: Held with his back on the fence in the clinch, the other man chest to chest with him (D220). He carries the weight (tires faster); exploited by knees and short punches. Only he can spin off.
values.UNDERHOOK: Has at least one underhook in the clinch (D261): the inside on a side, his arm under the other man's. Drives, turns on the fence, the double leg and trips, knees. In half guard (D263): the near-side underhook (on top, with the crossface): the pass on top, getting up and the sweep underneath.
values.WRIST_HELD: On top on the ground, the man underneath holds at least one of his wrists (D263): that hand can't punch, so his ground strikes are harder; the armbar and the tie-up are easier.
values.WRISTS_HELD: On top on the ground, both his wrists are held (D263): no ground strikes until he postures up and frees one.
values.BODY_LOCK: Has both underhooks in the clinch, the body lock (D261). The best grip for drives, trips and the double leg; the other man can barely punch, shoot or break.
values.OVERHOOK: The other man has an underhook on him in the clinch, so he has an overhook, the whizzer (D261). Spinning off the fence, overhook throws and punches off it; he can strip the underhook.
values.POSTURE_BROKEN: Posture pulled down in the clinch or guard (tied up from the bottom). No ground strikes until it wears off; later exploited by bottom submissions and sweeps.
values.POSTURED_UP: Sitting up in guard to throw a ground strike. Exploited by get-ups and tie-ups from the bottom, and by escapes from under side control, mount and the back.
values.ESCAPING: Underneath and working to get out (shrimping back to guard, bridging, turning out of the back): arms out and the back half turned (D130). Exploited by taking the back, the armbar from mount and the arm-triangle.
values.BIT_ON_FEINT: Bit on a feint: hands up and weight back for a moment (D131). Exploited by shots and clinch entries; a sprawl from it is late.
values.BLIND_SHOT: Shooting with nothing setting it up: no feint or strike just before it, no opening, standing (D131). The shot is worse, easier to read and to sprawl on, and costs more when it's stuffed.
values.DOWN: Knocked down, for the 2 s before he gets up (D141). Only a soccer kick or a stomp lands on him, and only where the rules allow them (PRIDE).
values.SLIPPING: Slipping a punch: head moved off the line for a moment (D180). Straight punches miss more; exploited by the uppercut.
values.COVERED: Covering up: hands high and elbows in (D180). Half the head damage gets through; exploited by shots to the body.
